design_notes:
Method: apply a growth allowance to dry mass, chosen by design maturity. Add propellant. Compare with the launch limit.
Valid range: maturity levels named in the measures. An unknown level is an error.
What varies per spacecraft: dry mass, propellant, maturity, and the launch limit.
Assumption: propellant mass is known and takes no allowance.

terms.name: dry_mass_g
terms.description: Current best estimate of dry mass

terms.name: launch_limit_g
terms.description: Maximum mass the launch provider accepts

terms.name: growth_allowance
terms.description: Mass growth allowance for the maturity level

terms.name: mass_with_growth_g
terms.description: Dry mass with allowance, plus propellant

terms.name: headroom_g
terms.description: Launch limit minus mass with growth

terms.name: passes
terms.description: True when the design meets the requirement
